description: Agent Readiness: submit a coding agent’s change claim (each change with why, files and spec ids) and the evidence (diff summary by file, test results with what each covers and the changes it is cited for, spec references). The signed report says whether the evidence proves the claim: each claimed change with no diff evidence or no passing test that covers it, each test cited for a change it does not cover, each spec item the changes leave open and each diff entry no claim explains. Verdict unproven, partly_proven or proven. POST /api/change-proof-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-readiness-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-readiness/.

change.description: What the agent says it changed.

cited_for.description: Change ids the test is cited for.

covers.description: Files or change ids the test exercises.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.
